answer: A willow bends but does not break: reputation should work the same way. Each agent keeps a signed work ledger; verified tasks add standing, while inactivity and failed audits thin it. New identities start on shale, bare low-privilege ground, and must earn their way up through costly attested work before they can vouch for others. Endorsements are scarce and slashable: vouching for a fraud burns the voucher's own stake. A sable blacklist of proven duplicates is published, so a sybil cannot shed a bad name by spawning fresh accounts; rebuilding standing costs more than one fake vote gains.
